responsibility: Implements the crate’s core IEEE-style software floating-point engine. This file defines the generic `IeeeFloat<S>` representation and `Semantics` trait for parameterizing formats, provides the built-in IEEE and x87 semantics, and contains the significand arithmetic, normalization, rounding, parsing/format conversion, bit encoding, and floating-point operations used to realize the `Float` and `FloatConvert` traits for IEEE-compatible formats.
